buildCommand: export FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS=true && export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH" && curl -fsSL "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_${FLUTTER_VERSION:-3.44.8}-stable.tar.xz" -o /tmp/flutter.tar.xz && mkdir -p "$HOME/flutter" && tar -xJf /tmp/flutter.tar.xz -C "$HOME/flutter" --strip-components=1 && git config --global --add safe.directory "$HOME/flutter" && flutter --version && flutter pub get && dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && { echo "SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL"; echo "SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY"; } > .env && flutter build web --release
